sv.title: Polisen utreder hot mot gymnasieskola i Skellefteå
sv.summary: Polisen i Skellefteå utreder just nu ett eventuellt olaga hot riktat mot Baldergymnasiet. En person är hämtad för förhör.

en.title: Police investigating threats against upper secondary school in Skellefteå
en.summary: Police in Skellefteå are currently investigating a possible unlawful threat directed at Baldergymnasiet. One person has been brought in for questioning.
